blocks.text: Mobile-first AI product photo and ad-creative generator for ecommerce sellers

Pixelcut is built around a simple use case: a seller with a phone and a product, no studio. Its dedicated ghost-mannequin generator removes the need to physically steam and shoot a garment on a mannequin, producing a clean hollow-body product shot from a single photo instead.

For marketplace sellers on Amazon, Etsy, and Shopify, Pixelcut's speed matters more than depth of feature set. Background removal, product photo generation, and ad-creative templates are all designed to be finished on a phone between listing uploads, with watermark-free PNG exports on paid plans.
Dedicated tool for hollow-body product shots from one garment photo
One-tap background removal for clean product cutouts
Turn product photos into ready-to-run ad creative
Clean PNG exports on paid plans
When a seller needs a fast ghost-mannequin shot without booking a studio or opening a desktop editor, Pixelcut's mobile-first workflow gets it done in minutes.
Our team can integrate Pixelcut into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
